derived_values.used_by: BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen signal time parameter

other_exits: Buy closed when MFI_Histogram buffer 1 equals 2 (bearish zone), Sell closed when buffer 1 equals 0 (bullish zone) - controlled by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input flags

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum determines sizing: LOT=fixed lots, BALANCE=percent of balance, FREEMARGIN=percent of free margin, LOSSFREEMARGIN=percent of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=percent of balance minus loss. MM input value serves as either lot size or percentage depending on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: The MFI_Histogram custom indicator has 3 buffers (0,1,2). Buffer 2 (Col array) provides zone identification: value 0 = bullish zone (MFI below LowLevel=40), value 2 = bearish zone (MFI above HighLevel=60), value 1 = neutral zone. Entry uses buffer 0 at SignalBar index: long when Col[0]>0 in bullish zone (Col[1]==0), short when Col[0]<2 in bearish zone (Col[1]==2). Exit signals are triggered by zone transitions. The HighLevel/LowLevel parameters (60/40) are passed to the custom indicator and define overbought/oversold thresholds. SignalBar defaults to 1 (previous completed bar). The CIsNewBar class controls bar-level execution. Position open/close functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) and GlobalVariableDel_ are from TradeAlgorithms.mqh - their full logic is not visible. SL/TP values of 1000/2000 points likely need digit adjustment for 5-digit brokers.
python_conversion_notes: The MFI_Histogram is a custom indicator not available in standard Python libraries. It must be replicated in Python: compute MFI values, then create a histogram with 3 zones based on HighLevel/LowLevel thresholds (buffer 0=histogram color/magnitude, buffer 1=zone identifier 0/1/2). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles all order execution including margin-mode position sizing - this logic must be reimplemented. The 5 margin modes (LOT, BALANCE, FREEMARGIN, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE) need careful implementation. SL/TP of 1000/2000 are in points not pips - verify whether digit adjustment is needed for 5-digit brokers. The new-bar guard using CIsNewBar must be replicated to ensure one signal per bar. Signal time tracking (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) is passed to position open functions - purpose unclear without seeing TradeAlgorithms.mqh.
